name: Markilo
oneLiner: Markilo is an open-source brand identity studio for Claude Code: it researches a product, designs original SVG identities, checks their originality and exports every asset — so developers and indie makers can get a real brand for what they build.

features: repository, site and competitor research with sourced findings
three genuinely different proposals; the user chooses
drawn wordmarks and icons as real SVG
complete asset export (favicons, app icons, social, tokens, guidelines)

primary: developers and indie makers who want a real brand for their product

positioning.tone: Like a small, excellent identity studio: sure of its eye, plain-spoken, never hyped. This is the showpiece — Markilo's own identity must be the most beautiful thing Markilo has made.
differentiators: it designs like a studio (point of view, drawn letterforms) rather than generating a logo

competitors.name: Brandmark
competitors.notes: heavy black B on yellow; generator aesthetic

competitors.name: LogoAI
competitors.notes: multicolour rounded 'A' with dot, playful AI look

competitors.name: Logo.com
competitors.notes: stacked LOGO letters in a blue circle

avoid: pens, pencils, brushes, magic wands, sparkles, palettes
a plain M monogram (the previous icon was an m with a vermilion stem)
the generic AI-gradient look; multicolour playful generator aesthetic
looking like a developer utility (terminal prompts, brackets, monospace-as-identity)
the product's objects drawn plainly (a logo grid, a vector pen nib, bezier handles)

notes: Redesign: nothing of the current identity (an m with a vermilion stem on #101218) must be kept. The name contains the word 'mark' — a maker's mark is the core of an identity studio. Letters m-a-r-k-i-l-o: k-i-l is a run of three ascending/x-height stems; 'lo' ends on a round; 'il' and 'ki' could share strokes. Category marks are bright, flat, heavy-sans and playful; Markilo should stand apart as editorial, crafted and studio-grade.
